text: Category order editor: replace up/down buttons with real drag-reorder

Done in 0b9d3c0. Up/down buttons replaced with a long-press drag handle
(pointerInput + detectDragGesturesAfterLongPress); crossing one row-height swaps
with the neighbour via the existing moveCategoryUp/Down edits (persistence/Save
unchanged). Long-press-to-start avoids fighting the screen's verticalScroll; rows
keyed by category + rememberUpdatedState so the handle tracks its item across swaps.
Handle icon is Icons.Default.Menu (material-icons-core; DragHandle is in the
extended set, not a dep). IMPORTANT: drag gestures aren't unit-testable under
Robolectric, so this is verified by compile + on-device only — flagged for the
T-29 device pass.
